selection: Round-robin across source annotation category, atom-count bins <=25/26..50/>50, and independent radius-two branch-signature tie proxy. Within each stratum sort the declared salted SHA256 of source ID and locus. No confirmed/rejected status used.

indexing.locus_atoms: zero based in source parser ordering

symmetry_proxy_boundary: Radius-two ties are sampling strata only, not proofs of constitutional symmetry or stereogenicity.
truth_contract: Independently assess typed constitutional carrier support and configuration distinction; archive exact ligand-exchange witnesses or exhaustive bounded map evidence. Experimental persistence requires separate published barrier/time evidence; otherwise unresolved for stability.
review_blinding: Algorithm statuses omitted from the review sheet. Automated prospective selection from historical development candidates, not an untouched holdout or completed independent human chemical review.
